correctness.rationale: Constructed a complete proof of the concept–maximal-independent-set correspondence, direct product over connected components, unique order-six tree P6 yielding N5, and all other trees of order <=6 yielding distributive lattices. The tree assertion was exhaustively certified from 1442 labelled Prüfer trees, with 360 six-vertex paths as the only failures; all 512 three-by-three contexts and an independent direct product example were also verified by the exact standard-library program. At q=t n^{-6/5}, expected 7-vertex trees are O(n^{-1/5}), short cycles vanish, and the path-count dependency-graph bound has worst overlap O(n^{-1/5}), giving the claimed rate and intensity alpha^3 t^5. Subcritical Markov and supercritical second-moment/isolation arguments establish the 0–1 bounds. No finite experiments are treated as infinite probability proofs.

value.rationale: Determines a meaningful structural property (distributivity and thus ideal-lattice representability) in a canonical random FCA null model, not just the number of concepts. Proves a sharp first transition, an exact Poisson window constant, and an explanatory minimal N5 component obstruction for all fixed rectangular aspect ratios. It requires combining nontrivial closure decomposition and exhaustive finite first-obstruction classification with sparse random-graph estimates; the critical exponent is not chosen arbitrarily.
